description:
Make the in-memory backend's path reads come from its own state, so it passes the shared conformance suite for path reads, decoding and commit-pinned reads.

## Background

`InMemoryStorage::read_path_bytes` (`crates/jit/src/storage/memory.rs:943-990`) ignores its `_at_commit` argument and reads `std::fs::read(root_path.join(path))` from the real disk, so in-memory tests observe whatever the host directory holds. `storage/test_support.rs` (`seed_repository_tree_fixture`) imports a file tree into memory state.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: In-memory path reads return bytes from the store's own state, never from the host filesystem.
- [hard] REQ-02: A commit-pinned read returns the state recorded for that commit, and a read at an unknown commit fails with the same error class as the JSON backend.
- [hard] REQ-03: The conformance suite includes path-read, decoding and commit-pinned read cases, and both backends pass them.
- [hard] REQ-04: A test that relied on the disk fallback seeds the store instead.
title: In-memory path reads serve the store's own commit-pinned state
